description: Creates a new notification channel. The configuration fields depend on the notification type (e.g., for slack: webhookURL; for ntfy: ntfyTopic, ntfyServerUrl; for discord: discordWebhookUrl).

applyExisting.description: Apply this notification to all existing monitors now

config.description: Type-specific configuration fields (e.g. webhookURL for slack, ntfyTopic for ntfy)

isDefault.description: Enable by default for new monitors

name.description: Human-readable name for this notification channel

type.description: Notification type (e.g. slack, ntfy, discord, telegram, webhook, smtp)

name: addNotification
title: Add Notification
